model_year.note: Label for the year whose specs are quoted. Not a statement about availability.

length_in.note: Secondary source: C/D 2027 Optiq Premium Luxury. Cadillac's 2027 Optiq page has no dimensions in text. Same figure on C/D's 2026 page.

awd.label: Dual motor, on Luxury and Sport
trims: Dual motor AWD (available feature on Luxury and Sport trims)
awd.note: Cadillac 2027 page: 'AVAILABLE DUAL MOTOR AWD'; 'Dual motor AWD with EPA-estimated 303 miles of range' listed under available features; range headline marked 'EPA estimated (RWD)'. The Optiq-V (separate C/D submodel) is not covered here.

charge_port.note: Key standard features: 'North American Charging System (NACS) onboard charge port'.

supercharger_access.note: Key standard features: 'North American Charging System (NACS) onboard charge port'.

cross_check.note: Tesla lists General Motors (GM) among manufacturers with access to NACS Superchargers; 'For new vehicles that are NACS-equipped, no adapter will be necessary.' Read through headless Edge (sources/tesla-supercharging-other-evs-rendered.html); curl gets HTTP 403.

us_status.note: Cadillac page titled '2027 OPTIQ | Small Electric SUV' with pricing, dealer and trade-in links.

epa_range.note: Excludes the Optiq-V (EPA 50620 and 50621, 278 and 250 mi), a performance variant left out like the Ioniq 5 N and GV60 Magma.

cargo_cu_ft.note: C/D 2026 Luxury 4dr w/1SC, cargo space behind the second row and behind the front row.

turning_circle_ft.note: C/D 2026 Luxury 4dr w/1SC, 'Turning Diameter / Radius, curb to curb (feet)'.
